title: Tokyo Pulse (The Yamanote Loop Extended Mix)
lyrics:
[Intro: ] [Spoken Word - Low, intimate vocal] Listen to the city breathe. It never stops. From the first train at Shinagawa to the last call in Kabukicho. I know these streets. I know the rhythm. Sing it back. Let the rhythm echo off the glass. Sing it back to the skyline. Sing it back to the night.
[Verse 1 -] Step out the door into the blinding neon glow The Yamanote line is moving fast but time is slow I pass the salarymen asleep upon the midnight train A million silent stories washing away in the evening rain The vending machines are humming, casting shadows on the street A warm canned coffee in my hand, I match the city’s beat This concrete jungle rhythm is the only life I understand A grid of glowing wire stretching out across the land I know the hidden alleys where the ramen steam rises high I know the rooftop gardens reaching up to touch the sky From the scramble of Shibuya where the oceans of people meet To the quiet shrines of Yoyogi hidden right off the street
[Pre-Chorus] Every flashing sign is a heartbeat Every narrow lane is a vein We are the electricity, we are the spark Igniting the shadows, lighting up the dark Feel the voltage rising, feel the sudden rush In the center of the madness, there’s a sudden hush
[Chorus - ] Sing it back to the Tokyo night Sing it back to the neon light I’m living in the center of the glowing wire Sing it back, let the frequency go higher Sing it back to the streets I know From the high-rise peaks to the streets below Sing it back, sing it back, let the echo fly Underneath the heavy, electric Tokyo sky Sing it back! (Oh, you gotta sing it back) Sing it back! (Underneath the Tokyo sky)
[Verse 2 ] Down in Shimokitazawa searching through the vintage racks Vinyl records spinning, laying down the classic tracks The izakaya lanterns swinging gently in the evening breeze A sudden scent of yakitori cutting through the autumn trees I walk the electronic labyrinth of Akihabara’s glow Where arcade sirens ring and the anime colors flow The sky tree standing like a beacon in the distant haze We are wandering forever in this endless, beautiful maze It’s a paradox of silence in a city of extreme noise A delicate balance of the chaos and the quiet poise You see the fashion kids in Harajuku walking down the lane Defying the tradition, breaking every single chain
[Pre-Chorus] Every flashing sign is a heartbeat Every narrow lane is a vein We are the electricity, we are the spark Igniting the shadows, lighting up the dark Feel the voltage rising, feel the sudden rush In the center of the madness, there’s a sudden hush
[Chorus] Sing it back to the Tokyo night Sing it back to the neon light I’m living in the center of the glowing wire Sing it back, let the frequency go higher Sing it back to the streets I know From the high-rise peaks to the streets below Sing it back, sing it back, let the echo fly Underneath the heavy, electric Tokyo sky
[Bridge] Sometimes I stop upon the bridge over the Sumida river Watch the boats glide by, watch the reflections shiver It’s a thousand years of history mixed with tomorrow’s dream Nothing in this metropolis is exactly as it seems We build the future on the ashes of the ancient past Moving at a speed that is too beautiful to last But I am anchored to the rhythm, I am grounded in the sound The Tokyo vibration coming straight up from the ground Listen. Just listen. The city is a song.
[Spoken Word - DJ Build Phase] Let the bass return. Let the pulse come back. Shinjuku. Roppongi. Ginza. Ueno. Every district is a different key. Every ward is a different frequency. Sing it back to me.
[Drop -  (Sing it back... Tokyo... Sing it back...) (Neon... Wire... Electric... Fire...)
[Verse 3 - ] Midnight on the expressway, the taillights blur to red A million thoughts of yesterday are circling in my head But the momentum pushes forward, there is no turning back We are speeding down the tunnel on this hyper-modern track The convenience store fluorescent is a sanctuary of light A glowing white oasis in the middle of the night From the underground subways to the towers of Roppongi hills The city gives you everything, the chills and the thrills I am a phantom in the scramble, a ghost in the machine A pixel on the largest screen that you have ever seen But I feel every single vibration, every single note I am the author of the rhythm that the skyline wrote
[Chorus] Sing it back to the Tokyo night Sing it back to the neon light I’m living in the center of the glowing wire Sing it back, let the frequency go higher Sing it back to the streets I know From the high-rise peaks to the streets below Sing it back, sing it back, let the echo fly Underneath the heavy, electric Tokyo sky Sing it back! (Let the frequency go higher!) Sing it back! (From the streets below!)
[Outro - Slowly fading, pulsing bass] Sing it back... The trains are sleeping now. The crows are waking up. The dawn is turning the sky a pale, electric blue.
